full_prompt_en: A square Dutch Golden Age-style landscape painting shows a broad river passing low wooded banks beneath towering summer clouds. The sky occupies more than half the frame, painted in pale blue with immense white and gray cloud columns that swell upward from the horizon. Darker cloud shadows gather at the left and along the upper edge, while sunlight breaks through the central openings. Below, the river stretches from the lower left toward a soft distant horizon, reflecting silver-blue light in broad calm bands. On the right foreground, a low sandy and rocky bank projects into the water, supporting a large spreading tree with a dense olive-green crown. Fine branches and scattered highlights give the foliage volume, while its trunk and roots anchor the near shore. Smaller trees and shrubs stand along the left bank and middle distance, their dark silhouettes framing the open water. A narrow pale path or exposed shore curves around the right-side tree and recedes behind it. Far beyond, muted land strips and a few indistinct structures lie under the bright cloud break. The painting differentiates near bark, leaves, and earth with fine strokes, while distant ground and sky soften into atmospheric layers. Warm daylight arrives from the central sky, lighting the top of the bank and the tree's outer leaves; deeper greens and browns gather beneath the canopy. The water remains luminous but not mirror-smooth, carrying subtle horizontal movement. No figures or readable text appear. The overall composition is expansive and balanced, with the tree and bank providing a grounded counterweight to the monumental cloud-filled sky.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形荷兰黄金时代风格风景画呈现宽阔河流流过低矮林岸，上方耸立巨大的夏季云层。天空占据一半以上画幅，浅蓝色里巨大的白灰云柱从地平线向上膨胀。较深云影聚在左侧及上沿，阳光从中央缺口透出。下方，河水从左下方延向柔和远方地平线，以宽阔平静色带反射银蓝光。右侧前景，一片低矮沙石岸伸入水中，托着一棵树冠浓密、向外铺展的大树。细枝和零星亮点让橄榄绿树叶有体积，树干与树根固定近岸。较小树木和灌木立在左岸与中景，深色剪影为开放水面构框。一条狭窄浅色小径或裸露岸线绕过右侧大树，退到其后。更远处，柔和土地色带和几处模糊结构位于明亮云隙下。绘画以细笔触区分近处树皮、叶片与土面，远地和天空则柔化成大气层次。暖日光从中央天空来到，照亮岸坡上层和树冠外叶；更深绿与棕色聚在树下。水面发亮却非完全镜面，保留细微水平动势。没有人物或可读文字。整体构图辽阔而平衡，树与岸坡为宏大的满云天空提供坚实对照。
style_prompt_en: Classical landscape painting balances finely textured near foliage and earth with broad atmospheric clouds and luminous water. Olive green, warm brown, silver blue, cream, and slate gray shift gradually in value, preserving natural depth. Cloud masses are modeled in rounded layered forms, with dark undersides and sunlit upper edges. Small detailed strokes sharpen near textures; the horizon dissolves into softer low-contrast planes. Light breaks through central openings, lifting selected surfaces and leaving sheltering shadow beneath dense masses. The overall effect is expansive, calm, and quietly monumental.
style_prompt_zh: 古典风景绘画以精细纹理的近处树叶和土地，平衡宽阔大气云层与发亮水面。橄榄绿、暖棕、银蓝、奶油和石板灰在明度上渐进变化，保留自然纵深。云团以圆润层叠形塑造，下部较深、上缘受阳光照亮。近处肌理由小细笔痕锐化，地平线则融入更柔的低反差平面。光从中央开口透过，抬亮局部表面，让密集色团下留庇护性阴影。整体辽阔、平静且安静壮阔。
theme_en: A broad river landscape beneath towering summer clouds
theme_zh: 巨大的夏季云层下，一片宽阔河流风景
name: Jacob van Ruisdael
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
